functions.label: Change User Types
functions.description: Switch functions on or off for a whole user type.

functions.label: Counsel Codes
functions.description: Link standing-counsel codes to departments.

functions.label: Keywords and Name Patterns
functions.description: Words and names that point a case to a department.

functions.label: Watchlist
functions.description: Cases a department always wants to follow.

functions.label: Refresh Court Masters
functions.description: Reload case types and benches from the court, and run the connection check.

functions.label: Fetch Court Data Again
functions.description: Fetch a cause list, a case or an order again from the court, and retry failed fetches.

functions.label: System Settings
functions.description: Change system settings.

functions.label: Manage Designations
functions.description: Keep the State-wide list of posts up to date.

functions.label: Scoring Weights and Bands
functions.description: How strongly each signal counts, and the strong and possible bands.

functions.label: Decide Admin Tickets
functions.description: Decide the requests that need the Super Administrator (reserved to the Super Administrator).

functions.label: Case Assistant Intake
functions.description: See which court orders and filings went to the Case Assistant, and retry failures.

functions.label: Data Collection
functions.description: Start, pause and order the historical load, fetch single cases and check duplicates.

functions.label: System Health
functions.description: See whether the court APIs and ASLMS services work, and test a court API with one call.

functions.label: Acknowledge Alerts
functions.description: Mark an alert as seen and dealt with.

functions.label: Use the Case Assistant
functions.description: Ask the Case Assistant about cases and court orders

functions.label: Read the Audit Log
functions.description: Search who did what, and when.

functions.label: See the Office's Cases
functions.description: Cases owned by, assigned to, or sent to the offices you belong to.

functions.label: See All Cases
functions.description: Every case in the State, in every department.

functions.label: Search the High Court
functions.description: Look up a case at the court by CNR, number, party, advocate or filing number.

functions.label: Claim Cases
functions.description: Take a recommended or unclaimed case for the department.

functions.label: Dismiss Recommendations
functions.description: Say a recommended case is not the department's.

functions.label: Suggest Another Department
functions.description: Point a recommended case to the department it belongs to.

functions.label: Ask for a Transfer
functions.description: Ask another department to take over a claimed case.

functions.label: Decide Transfers
functions.description: Accept or refuse a transfer asked of the department.

functions.label: Assign Cases
functions.description: Choose the responsible unit and the dealing officer for a case of the department.

functions.label: Stop Watching
functions.description: End the department's watching role on a case.

functions.label: See Private Records Too
functions.description: With See All Cases: notes, documents and remarks kept private to an office.

functions.label: Take Over a Case
functions.description: Take over a case assigned to a colleague in the same department.

functions.label: Send Cases Held by an Office
functions.description: Send on a case that is with an office rather than an officer; whoever has a case can always send it.

functions.label: Recall Cases
functions.description: Call a case of the department back from whoever has it.

functions.label: Track Pending Cases
functions.description: See every case of the department that is waiting on someone, with due and overdue alerts.

functions.label: State Dashboard
functions.description: See the State-wide dashboard.

functions.label: Upload Documents
functions.description: Add court papers and internal documents (PDF, Word, images) to a case.

functions.label: See Documents
functions.description: Open documents you are allowed to see.

functions.label: Download Documents
functions.description: Save a copy of a document you are allowed to see.

functions.label: Confirm Next Dates
functions.description: Confirm, reject or enter the next date read from an order.

functions.label: Add Notes
functions.description: Write notes on a case; a note is never edited, a correction is a new note.

functions.label: Read Notes Shared with Counsel
functions.description: See notes and documents marked for the Standing Counsel.

functions.label: Read Office-only Notes
functions.description: See notes kept private to your own office.

functions.label: Manage Offices
functions.description: Add, rename, move and close departments and directorates.

functions.label: Department Reports
functions.description: Run and download the department's reports.

functions.label: State Reports
functions.description: Run and download reports across all departments.

functions.label: Set the Stage
functions.description: Record where the department's work on a case stands.

functions.label: See Users
functions.description: See the people of the offices you look after.

functions.label: Add Users
functions.description: Create a sign-in for a new officer, with a user type, in an office you look after.

functions.label: Edit User Details
functions.description: Change a person's name, designation and contact details.

functions.label: Change a User's Type
functions.description: Move a person to another user type.

functions.label: Turn Sign-in on or Off
functions.description: Stop or restore a person's access; nothing they did is deleted.

functions.label: Give or Take Single Functions
functions.description: Switch one function on or off for one person, within your own functions.

functions.label: Reset Passwords
functions.description: Set a new password for a person.

functions.label: Propose a New Head
functions.description: Ask the Super Administrator to change the head of a department, and follow the ticket.

roles.label: State Oversight Officer
roles.description: Read-only view of all cases, with the State dashboards and reports.

roles.label: Super Administrator
roles.description: Holds every function and manages access for the whole State.

roles.label: Head of Department
roles.description: All cases of the department and its directorates, with approvals and oversight.

roles.label: Department Administrator
roles.description: Manages the department's users, counsel codes and keywords; reviews recommendations and claims cases.

roles.label: Department Officer
roles.description: Works on cases assigned to them: moves the case, adds notes and documents, and receives alerts.

roles.label: Directorate Officer
roles.description: Works on the cases of their own directorate.

roles.label: Referral Reviewer
roles.description: Reviews cases with a department officer's reviewing functions, without ownership or the case's movement.

roles.label: Standing Counsel
roles.description: Cases they appear in, with the notes and documents shared with counsel.

roles.label: Central Operator
roles.description: Looks after unclaimed cases and data quality.

roles.label: Auditor
roles.description: Read-only case records and the audit log.
